documents.text: Project Orion will launch on 14 May. The release owner is Maya. The team must complete security review before launch.
The River research group collected samples from the north bank on 3 June. The samples are stored in freezer B.
Atlas onboarding includes a two-week training period. New employees should contact the people operations team for access.
The community garden waters seedlings every Tuesday morning. Tomatoes should be planted in the sunny southern beds.
